crates/xsd/src/bigint/compat.rs (1)
`169-171`: **🚀 Performance & Scalability** | **🔵 Trivial** | **⚡ Quick win** **Replace the full decimal rendering in the `div_rem_pow10` guard with a bit-length bound.** `decimal_digits()` calls `self.to_string()`. That is a quadratic binary-to-decimal conversion plus an allocation, used only to count digits. `Decimal::new` reaches this guard through `div_rem_pow10` every time a spilled coefficient has trailing zeros. `Decimal::mul_big` reaches it the same way. In `Decimal::new` the guard can never fire, because `zeros ≤ trailing_decimal_zeros < decimal_digits`. Each canonicalization therefore pays one full conversion before the division. A conservative bound gives the same result without the conversion. If `exponent ≥ digits_for_bits(bit_len)`, then `|self| < 10^exponent`. This may contribute to the reported Decimal multiplication regression; the link is not measured.
⚡ Proposed fix ```diff - if exponent >= self.decimal_digits() { + if exponent >= crate::exact::cost::digits_for_bits(self.bit_len()) { return (Self::zero(), self.clone()); } ```
